headline: Mooring County Surges; Fronts Shift Across Theater
war_summary: The front at Mooring County has intensified since the last edition, with Colonial and Warden losses now accelerating to roughly 940 and 660 per hour and three base changes recorded in the past two hours, pushing the sector to the top of the activity ledger. Callums Cape, previously the bloodiest theater, shows a cooling trend; hourly casualties have fallen to about 200 Colonial and 260 Warden, though the two‑hour window still registers acceleration on the Warden side. Linn Mercy’s casualty flow remains near zero, yet five captures or neutralisations in the last six hours keep the area contested. Weathered Expanse, which spiked earlier, is now cooling, with Colonial and Warden losses dropping to 17 and 9 per hour respectively and no fresh flips in the last two hours. Marban Hollow stays largely quiet, recording only a single event in six hours and modest, steady casualties. Stlican Shelf has reversed its earlier decline, showing a sharp one‑hour rise to six Colonial and 24 Warden casualties per hour. Stonecradle’s earlier uptick has faded, with only minor losses and no recent base changes.
